## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies the write-reviewer-findings.sh schema change aspect of DD1 (2-key schema accepted by the write pipeline).

## What to modify
Update tests/scripts/test-write-reviewer-findings.sh:

1. CHANGE all success-path fixtures from 3-key to 2-key schema:
   - Old: pipe {"scores":{...},"findings":[...],"summary":"..."} to write-reviewer-findings.sh
   - New: pipe {"findings":[...],"summary":"..."} to write-reviewer-findings.sh
   - Assertion: still exits 0, still outputs a SHA-256 hash
2. ADD test_write_reviewer_two_key_schema_succeeds: 2-key schema piped in → exits 0, produces hash
3. ADD test_write_reviewer_scores_key_rejected: 3-key schema with scores key → exits non-zero
4. REMOVE tests that verify scores normalization behavior:
   - test that verifies 'dimensions' key is normalized to 'scores'
   - test that verifies nested score objects {score:N, rationale:...} are flattened
   (These normalization steps will be removed from write-reviewer-findings.sh)

## Given/When/Then
Given: {"findings":[],"summary":"clean"} piped to write-reviewer-findings.sh
When: the script runs
Then: exits 0, a SHA-256 hash is printed to stdout, findings file is written

## RED markers
.test-index entries:
- tests/scripts/test-write-reviewer-findings.sh [test_write_reviewer_two_key_schema_succeeds]
- tests/scripts/test-write-reviewer-findings.sh [test_write_reviewer_scores_key_rejected]

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] test_write_reviewer_two_key_schema_succeeds exists
  Verify: grep -q 'test_write_reviewer_two_key_schema_succeeds' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-write-reviewer-findings.sh
- [ ] test_write_reviewer_scores_key_rejected exists
  Verify: grep -q 'test_write_reviewer_scores_key_rejected' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-write-reviewer-findings.sh
- [ ] .test-index has RED markers for new tests
  Verify: grep -q 'test_write_reviewer_two_key_schema_succeeds' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: UPDATE tests: write-reviewer-findings.sh accepts 2-key schema, no scores normalization
